entities.name: WLAN offload control
entities.description: Procedure for handling offloading of traffic to WLAN in networks that support this feature. The permission to offload is determined for the UE and PDN connection.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The user equipment for which WLAN offload permission is determined.

entities.name: PDN connection
entities.description: The Packet Data Network connection for which WLAN offload permission is determined.

entities.name: Offload permission
entities.description: Condition determining whether traffic can be offloaded to WLAN for a specific UE and PDN connection.

relations.description: The WLAN offload control procedure establishes the offload permission condition for UE and PDN connection.
Offload permission is determined specifically for the UE.
Offload permission is determined specifically for the PDN connection.
